name: anim_hira_form
subject: a very tall, extremely muscular horse man made of glossy brown paint with messy cream swirls
desc: The faceless paint humanoid finishes forming: the legs pull up out of the puddle into straight human legs with bare feet, the head blob stretches forward into a long horse muzzle, the upright ears and the spiky dripping mane pull up out of the paint, the mouth splits into a big toothy grin, and the wide-open eyes open last. Slow, sticky, viscous, dripping. It ends exactly in the standing pose of the last frame.
